## Coaching Note

**You missed a quiet move that wins material.** When your opponent's queen is undefended and your knight attacks their unprotected rook, look for a pawn push that forces the issue. Here, c3 attacks the queen (which can't move safely without losing the rook on g1 to your knight). After White captures c3, you play Nxg1, winning the rook. Quiet moves often win games—don't just look for checks and captures!
